transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, my family brought me in. It was about what happened down at the fair. I was giving a talk, and I... I climbed up onto the tractor. I kept jerking the controls around to show the crowd the new pattern. And I just... I couldn't make myself stop doing it, even with folks yelling at me to get down. So, here I am.
Can you tell me if you've ever had an episode where you felt extremely agitated, had rapid thoughts, or behaved in a way that was out of character for you, like a sudden urge to act impulsively?

Yeah, I guess you could say my thoughts get going pretty fast. My head just runs so fast sometimes with... well, planting schedules, market prices, soil readings, and... messages I need to decode. It gets to where I can't even catch one thought before the next one just shoves it right aside. It's hard to keep up with it all.
Can you tell me if you’ve been having trouble telling what’s real and what isn’t, or if you’ve been thinking that something is true that others say isn’t?

Well, my wife would probably say yes to that. She keeps bringing out the lender's plain paperwork, trying to show me that everything is normal. But... I know what I'm looking at. 

When I go through the yield maps and those new drone reports, there are these odd numbers in them. They aren't just data or glitches. They're coded warnings. I know for a fact that folks are trying to take the farm right out from under me, even if she won't see it.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or felt your mood was extremely elevated or irritable, lasting for several days or more?

Yeah, I have stretches like that. Some mornings I wake up and it just feels like the whole valley is opening up for me. I'll be out there, just... grinning at nothing, feeling like I can take on the whole season by myself. 

But during those same times, if one of the hired hands questions how I'm doing things, or if my wife tells me I need to slow down... well, I get real short. I snap at them like they've just insulted the family name. It just flares right up, and it'll stay like that for days on end.

Can you tell me if there was a specific time when your mood was extremely elevated or irritable for at least one week, and during that time you had increased goal-directed activity, racing thoughts, or a decreased need for sleep?

Yeah, that happens. When I get going like that, I just can't seem to stop. I'll go from fixing a section of fence right over to recalibrating the sprayer, and then I'm calling suppliers before it's even time for breakfast. 

By noon, I've usually started five more jobs than a whole crew could finish in a week. I just feel like I have to keep moving, keep getting things done, even if I'm jumping from one thing to the next without finishing the first.
Have you ever seen, heard, or sensed something that others around you don’t seem to notice, or have you ever believed something strongly that turned out not to be true?

Yes, I... I hear things that other folks don't seem to catch. 

Out by the north pasture, especially right around dusk, I hear these voices. Clear as day. They come right out of the irrigation lines. They'll tell me exactly which rows of crops are poisoned and which ones are blessed. 

And the thing is, I hear them even when I'm just going about my normal business, you know? It's not just during those times when I'm all fired up and rushing around. I hear them on regular weeks, too.
Do the voices you hear or the things you believe happen only when you're feeling extremely high or low, or do they happen even when your mood is more normal?

They happen when my mood is normal, too. Like I said, it's not just when I'm all wound up. 

There were several quieter weeks... weeks where I wasn't especially energized or feeling like I could take on the world. I was just going about my normal routine. But I still heard the irrigation lines talking to me. And I still firmly believed that the farm data I was looking at was carrying those hidden warnings about the crops. So, yes, it happens even when my mood is just fine.

Can you tell me if the things you believe or the voices you hear change depending on how you're feeling emotionally, or do they stay pretty much the same no matter if you're feeling high, low, or normal?

Well, they stay pretty much the same, honestly. I mean, they don't just happen when I'm feeling normal. Like, during those months when I was hardly sleeping at all... when I was pushing the farm expansion day and night and just going a hundred miles an hour... I was still hearing those voices in the irrigation lines. And I was still reading those hidden warnings in the yield maps. So, yeah, it doesn't seem to matter if I'm all fired up or just having a regular week. The voices and the warnings are still there.
Can you tell me if the messages you decode from the yield maps or the voices you hear in the irrigation lines ever occur when you are not experiencing an elevated or irritable mood?

Yes, they do. Like I mentioned earlier, it's not just when I'm feeling all wound up or irritable. 

There were a good few weeks where things were just quiet. I wasn't feeling particularly energized, and I wasn't feeling like I was on top of the world or anything grand like that. Just... normal. But even during those quieter weeks, I still heard the irrigation lines talking to me out there. And I still completely believed that the data I was looking at for the farm was giving me those hidden warnings. So, yes, it happens even when my mood isn't elevated.

Can you tell me if the messages you decode from the yield maps or the voices you hear in the irrigation lines ever occur when you're not in one of those high-energy or irritable moods, like during times when you're feeling more down or even neutral?

Yeah, like I think I just mentioned a minute ago... yes, it happens then, too. 

There were several quieter weeks where I wasn't especially energized or feeling grand at all. Just neutral, regular days. But I still heard the lines talking out there, and I still firmly believed the farm data was carrying those hidden warnings. It doesn't stop just because my mood levels out.

Can you tell me if the voices you hear or the messages you see in the data ever happen when you're not in one of those high-energy periods or any kind of mood episode at all — like during times when your mood is completely stable and you're just going about your regular day?

Yeah, I feel like we're kind of going in circles here, Doc, but yes. I've had several quieter weeks where I wasn't energized or feeling grand or anything like that. My mood was completely stable. But even during those regular times, I still heard the irrigation lines talking to me, and I still fully believed that the farm data was carrying those hidden warnings. The mood doesn't seem to make a difference with those things.

Can you tell me if the voices you hear or the messages you see in the data ever happen even when you're not going through any kind of mood episode at all — like when you're feeling completely emotionally stable and just going about your regular day?

Look, doc, I don't know how many different ways I can say this. Yes. Like I keep telling you, I've had several quieter weeks where my mood was just fine. I wasn't feeling overly energized, I wasn't feeling grand or anything. Just a normal, stable guy going about my work. But the lines were still talking to me. I still heard them. And I still knew, without a doubt, that the farm data was giving me those hidden warnings. It happens whether my mood is up, down, or perfectly normal.

Can you tell me if the voices you hear or the messages you see in the data happen even when you're not going through any kind of mood episode at all—like when you're feeling completely emotionally stable and just going about your regular day?

I feel like a broken record here, doc, but yes. I really don't know how else to explain it to you. Like I've said, there were several quiet weeks where I wasn't energized at all. I wasn't feeling grand or anything out of the ordinary. Just completely stable. But even then, I still heard the lines talking out in the field, and I still fully believed the farm data was carrying those hidden warnings. It just doesn't go away when my mood goes back to normal.

Can you tell me if the voices you hear or the messages you see in the data happen even when you're not going through any kind of mood episode at all—like when you're feeling completely emotionally stable and just going about your regular day?

Doc, we've gone over this a few times now. I'm not sure why we keep covering the exact same ground, but yes. My answer hasn't changed. 

There were several quieter weeks where my mood was completely fine. I wasn't especially energized or feeling grand at all. Just a normal, stable week. But even then, I still heard the irrigation lines talking, and I still fully believed the farm data was carrying those hidden warnings. It happens even when my mood is completely level.

The presence of mood symptoms alongside psychosis raises the possibility of Schizoaffective disorder, manic type (F25.1), but insufficient evidence to confirm mood episode duration or dominance.

The patient's responses continue to show symptoms consistent with both disorders. The presence of mood elevation with increased goal-directed activity, decreased need for sleep, and racing thoughts supports F25.1 (Bipolar disorder, current episode manic without psychotic symptoms). The fixed, culturally incongruent beliefs about coded warnings and others trying to take the farm supports F23.1 (Delusional disorder). No features have been reported that rule out either condition.

The patient's experiences of hearing voices and holding fixed beliefs about coded warnings support F25.1 (Schizoaffective disorder) and F23.1 (Acute polymorphic psychotic disorder). No new information was provided that rules out either diagnosis at this time.
